description: Build the full browsable navigation so ALL nine books and their 54 chapters are viewable from the site, with a clear landing page listing every book. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the working mkdocs.yml). This is the core of the user request: '모든 책을 볼 수 있게' (so all books can be viewed).
steps: Create a dedicated site landing page that lists all 9 books with links to each book index. Prefer a new file that does NOT touch prose: create `docs_home.md` (or `index.md`) at repo root containing an H1 title and a Korean list linking to each books/NN-*/00-index.md. If you introduce index.md at repo root, ensure it does not collide with README.md; set it as the nav Home. Keep English originals untouched.

In mkdocs.yml, write a complete explicit `nav:` tree: Home -> the new landing page; then one section per book (9 sections) titled with the book's Korean+English title (e.g., '오멜라스: 요한계시록 (Revelation)'), each section listing its 00-index.md ('책 소개' or the book title) followed by chapter-01.md .. chapter-06.md labeled '제1장'..'제6장'. Derive titles from each file's H1 if practical, otherwise use the chapter numbers.

Confirm the existing relative .md links inside each 00-index.md '## 장 목록' (e.g., [제1장: 강남의 복음](chapter-01.md)) resolve on the built site. MkDocs rewrites *.md links to page URLs; --strict will flag any that do not resolve. Do NOT edit the link text or targets in the prose files.

Ensure canon/ documents and the English originals remain reachable if desired (optional secondary nav section 'Canon / 정본 자료' linking canon/*.md and the English README.md), or keep them excluded from nav via exclude_docs. Either way the build must be --strict clean.
Run `python3 -m mkdocs build --strict` and then enumerate the output: confirm site/ contains a rendered page for each of the 9 book indexes and all 54 chapters.
acceptance_criteria: The site landing/home page lists all 9 books, each linking to that book's index page.
mkdocs.yml nav contains 9 book sections, each exposing its 00-index plus 6 chapter pages (54 chapters total navigable).
`python3 -m mkdocs build --strict` exits 0 with no unresolved-link or nav warnings.
The built ./site contains an HTML page for every book index and every one of the 54 chapters.
Relative .md links inside the book index pages resolve to valid built pages (verified by --strict passing).
No novel prose file or English original is modified.
verification: for b in 01-revelation 02-genesis 03-exodus 04-judges 05-psalms 06-proverbs 07-new-testament 08-acrophyia 09-infancy-gospel; do for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06; do test -f site/books/$b/chapter-$n/index.html || test -f site/books/$b/chapter-$n.html || echo MISSING $b $n; done; done
git status --porcelain books canon README.md ideation.md page-1.md  (must be empty)
